sections.title: Intake
sections.conclusion: Baseline fields and source anchors establish whether the proposal can be reviewed at all.

sections.title: Claims and evidence
findings: Proposal document read by reasoning layer: yes
Requested: Fund a 12-month Governance Incentives Framework project to research, model, test, document, and propose governance incentive mechanisms for Cardano.

Deliverables: Governance Incentives Framework, public dataset and dashboard, documented incentive model and formula outputs, research publications, controlled incentive pilot findings, Governance Incentives Framework CIP, governance integration pathway, final financial and milestone report

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The project will evaluate governance incentive mechanisms through research, data, modeling, controlled testing, and community input before presenting adoption decisions to governance.

Claim (governance, independently_verifiable, medium materiality): The Governance Incentives Working Group has mapped 49 relevant efforts, proposals, research papers, tools, and initiatives related to Cardano governance incentives.

Claim (governance, independently_verifiable, high materiality): During Cardano's first year of on-chain governance, active DReps declined in every 12-epoch period, the DRep Gini coefficient increased from 0.92 to 0.94, and 11-16 DReps represented 51% of voting power.

Claim (governance, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): Poorly designed governance incentives could reward surface-level activity, reinforce voting-power concentration, encourage gaming, or spend treasury resources without meaningful governance value.

Claim (technical, supported_in_proposal, high materiality): The project will deliver seven staged milestones over 12 months, moving from discovery and framework design through data collection, modeling, dashboarding, controlled testing, and final governance integration.

Claim (adoption, supported_in_proposal, medium materiality): The proposal sets KPI targets including 50+ unique governance actors engaged, 10+ public workshops, 12 monthly progress updates, 50+ simulation scenarios, at least 99% monitoring service availability, and less than 1 hour data update latency.
missing: Independent evidence for: The named team members claim Cardano governance, Catalyst delivery, research, blockchain consulting, and public-sector experience relevant to the proposed work.
sections.conclusion: Each claim must map to replayable public evidence; proposer assertions alone are not enough for confidence.

sections.title: Treasury analysis
findings: Six-month treasury flow regime: unknown (stale snapshot) (basis: total inflow (tau + donations) vs enacted withdrawals)
sections.conclusion: Treasury votes require a higher bar because they consume shared ADA and create precedent.

sections.title: Risk review
sections.conclusion: Risk is not a side note; unmitigated execution or governance risk can dominate an otherwise attractive proposal.

sections.title: Counterargument pass
findings: Strongest YES: the proposal substantiates "The project will evaluate governance incentive mechanisms through research, data, modeling, controlled testing, and community input before presenting adoption decisions to governance." and clears the evidence gates.

Strongest NO: a material claim is unsupported — "The named team members claim Cardano governance, Catalyst delivery, research, blockchain consulting, and public-sector experience relevant to the proposed work." — so cost or precedent may outweigh the benefit.
Strongest hold: if claims cannot be tied to replayable evidence, abstaining avoids overclaiming certainty.
sections.conclusion: A defensible rationale must show the best opposing case before it reaches a vote.

sections.title: Synthesis
findings: Final vote must be derived from completed sections above, not from a prose summary.
The public rationale should name the decisive section and the strongest counterargument.
sections.conclusion: The vote is only credible if the assessment tree shows enough work for a skeptical delegator to audit.
